notes: All strains are MG1655 carrying the heterologous Csp231I RM system (WT p18, C+R- p24, C-R+ p30) plus a protective MTase plasmid; no plasmid-free strain, so is_control left out (p18 is the comparison baseline but not a reference genotype). Temperature and shaking not given.

growth_phase.q: At about mid log phase the cells were harvested

genotype_class.q: Cultures of E. coli MG1655 carrying pMCsp231 with additional protective MTase gene on ACYC177 derivative, and with plasmid with WT RM (p18)

treatment.q: Cultures of E. coli MG1655 carrying following plasmids: pMCsp231 (additional protective MTase gene on ACYC177 derivative), and plasmid with RMs of interest: WT (p18) and two variants

inducer_added.q: Cultures of E. coli MG1655 carrying following plasmids: pMCsp231 (additional protective MTase gene on ACYC177 derivative), and plasmid with RMs of interest: WT (p18) and two variants

transcription_arrested.q: Cultures of E. coli MG1655 carrying following plasmids: pMCsp231 (additional protective MTase gene on ACYC177 derivative), and plasmid with RMs of interest: WT (p18) and two variants

mixed_organism.q: Cultures of E. coli MG1655 carrying following plasmids

assay_class.q: Total RNA was extracted with RiboPure (Ambion) in two biological replicates.

rrna_removal.q: RNA libraries were rRNA depleted using Ribo-Zero rRNA Removal Kit (Bacteria)
